newsitem.title: CHINA: China insurer pays out $42 mln for flood losses.
newsitem.headline: China insurer pays out $42 mln for flood losses.

text.p: Chinese commercial insurer China Pacific Insurance Co has paid out 350 million yuan ($42 million) to tens of thousands of families and firms hit by flooding this year, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

By the end of November, Pacific Insurance had paid out claims in nine of the regions worst affected by the floods, including areas of southwestern Guizhou and Guangxi provinces and northern Hebei province, Xinhua said without giving details.
Pacific Insurance had collected 9.0 billion yuan in insurance premiums over the past 11 months, it said.
State media has said that floods in 1996 caused losses of more than 200 billion yuan.
The People's Insurance Group, China's largest insurer, is expected to pay out a total of 3.7 billion yuan in compensation for flood-related damage this year.
